messages:
ceo_alex: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands thread — quick follow-up from the roadmap section. Wanted to surface a few questions we didn’t have time for.
vp_product_maya: Fire away — we’ll answer in thread.
eng_manager_joe: Quick one: when we say ‘production-first’ in the deck, what’s the single most important metric we expect customers to feel? latency, predictability, or cost?
ceo_alex: Great Q. If forced to pick one it’s predictability. Low variance in latency and cost is what keeps apps from switching. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
pm_sam: Follow-up: does predictability mean we prioritize Dedicated vs Hosted for product investments?
vp_product_maya: We continue to invest in all three modes. Practically: hosted is biggest velocity win for PLG, dedicated is priority for customers at scale (SLA + reserved capacity), private gets deeper enterprise work (security/compliance). Roadmap splits features by mode, not by priority.
ana_research: Are we changing how we market our thesis — “model ownership -> serving”? I hear competitors leaning hard into model IP.
ceo_alex: No pivot. Our edge is helping teams win with serving economics + ops. We acknowledge model innovations matter, but we win when customers can reliably ship LLM features. Messaging will be sharper on serving ROI.
eng_manager_joe: For engineering planning: any change to model onboarding cadence? we currently onboard one new major architecture per quarter.
vp_product_maya: Keep cadence but tighten vetting. New models should clear perf checks (latency P99, mem use) and a small eval suite before catalog publish. We’ll publish updated checklists next week.
ops_lead_kate: On the SLA front — do we plan to offer a firm latency SLA for hosted customers or keep it for Dedicated only?
ceo_alex: Dedicated SLA stays firm. For hosted: we’ll introduce SLO-backed tiers with credits for regressions, not hard SLA at first. This gives us flexibility while improving reliability commitments.
pm_sam: Competitive ask — several prospects ask how we differ from managed endpoint + marketplace combos. Short pitch?
vp_product_maya: Short: unified runtime + routing + cost controls. Customers get consistent API across hosted/dedicated/private, built-in batching/cache, and tooling to trace cost/quality per token. That operational view is the differentiator.
ana_research: Will we publish more bench docs or public perf profiles? those help sales and engineers evaluate faster.
ceo_alex: Yes — more transparent perf profiles are on the roadmap Q2. Expect per-model latency curves by sequence length and hardware.
eng_manager_joe: Can we get a prioritized list of engineering asks from product so teams can align sprint goals?
pm_sam: I’ll post a short PRD tonight with top-5 items mapped to owners and estimated effort.
eng_manager_joe: Awesome, thanks.
deploy-bot: deploy: prod/runtime/1.84 rolled out at 2765432160 — no incidents reported.
ceo_alex: That’s it from me — thanks. If you’ve got follow-ups drop them here or ping me directly. :sparkles:
